questions.stem: A 65-year-old man presents to his primary care physician with complaints of poor sleep quality and daytime fatigue. His wife reports that he frequently moves his legs and sometimes kicks while sleeping, causing her to wake up. She also notes that these movements occur every 20 to 40 seconds and last throughout the night. Which of the following statements is true regarding this patient's most likely diagnosis?
questions.stemHtml: A 65-year-old man presents to his primary care physician with complaints of poor sleep quality and daytime fatigue. His wife reports that he frequently moves his legs and sometimes kicks while sleeping, causing her to wake up. She also notes that these movements occur every 20 to 40 seconds and last throughout the night. Which of the following statements is true regarding this patient's most likely diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: The condition is commonly associated with restless legs syndrome.

options.label: B
options.text: The movements occur predominantly during REM sleep.

options.label: C
options.text: The diagnosis is confirmed by polysomnography showing alpha wave intrusions.

options.label: D
options.text: First-line treatment involves selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs).
